children.text: Know which app I'm dictating into
Notices the app you're dictating into, like Outlook or Slack, so your style can fit it. Checked on this computer; nothing is sent anywhere.
Reads a little of the text around your cursor, so dictation continues your sentence and spells names the way they're already written.
Sent only to your AI cleanup provider (OpenRouter) with the dictation. Never saved, and never sent to a speech engine.
Apps whose text is never read, not even by Command Mode. Password fields, terminals and FioriVoce itself are always skipped.
Styles change how AI cleanup writes, so they only apply while it's on.
Turn on Know which app I'm dictating into so your style can fit each app.
Writes in a tone that fits where you are: polished for email, relaxed for chat. A cleanup profile you pick still comes first.
Outlook, Gmail, Mail, Thunderbird and more.
Hi Sam, thanks for the notes. I'll send the draft by Friday.
Notion, Slack, Teams, Google Chat and more.
Build's fixed, I'll deploy it after lunch
WhatsApp, Messages, Telegram, Discord and more.
Are you free for dinner on Saturday? It's my treat.
Everything else, like Word, Google Docs and VS Code.
Remember to water the plants before we leave.
Put an app or website in a different style, like Notion in Work messages.
